subject: CloudHarbor syndicate incentive onboarding and eligibility
messages:
From: Kate Lin <kate@cloudharbor.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudHarbor Partnerships <partnerships@cloudharbor.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question — partner-funded trial incentives for Marketplace list

Jordan —

Great to meet you at Summit last week. CloudHarbor is moving forward with a Marketplace listing for our managed data platform and we'd love Redwood to join a co-funded trial program for a small cohort of our channel customers.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide partner-sourced promotional credits tied to Marketplace onboarding (3-month trial, $5k credit per account, up to 10 accounts) and a lightweight promo contract? Our legal team can accept standard partner terms but asked for a short SOW/usage estimate to speed procurement.

Goals:
- Give our integrators an easy low-friction way to demo Redwood performance on real workloads
- Ensure usage doesn't exceed the intended pilot quota
- Track redemption via Marketplace/Partner portal so both sides can reconcile consumption

Are you able to share approval requirements and an ETA for a draft SOW? We can move quickly if Redwood can confirm eligibility for partner-sourced credits and provide the billing/activation flow.

Thanks — Kate
Kate Lin
Head of Ecosystem, CloudHarbor
kate@cloudharbor.io
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: sample-pilot-cohort.csv (list of integrator accounts)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lin <kate@cloudharbor.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — partner-funded trial incentives for Marketplace list

Hi Kate —

Thanks for the clear ask and the sample cohort. We can support partner-sourced promotional credits for Marketplace-driven pilots, but need to confirm a couple of operational and compliance pieces before I can sign off on the numbers you proposed.

Quick checklist from our side (initial):
- Eligibility: partner must be registered in our partner portal and have a valid reseller agreement (looks good from a quick search)
- Quota guardrails: we enforce per-account caps and an aggregate pilot cap (proposed: $5k/account, 10 accounts = $50k aggregate is OK pending approval)
- Activation flow: credits are issued as time-bound entitlements tied to Marketplace account IDs; partner portal activation + email trigger to end-customer is required
- Billing reconciliation: we need a usage-estimate spreadsheet and an SOW line item with usage buckets — can you share the expected token/ingest volumes?

Looping in Vanessa and Ben to confirm operations and pricing approval: Vanessa — can you confirm SLA/activation lead times for $50k aggregate? Ben — any constraints on deal labelling/discounting for Marketplace-funded promos?

If useful I can draft a short SOW + redemption flow and attach the activation checklist so your legal/procurement can sign off quickly.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

---
Jordan Blake
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — partner-funded trial incentives for Marketplace list

Jordan / Ben —

We can approve a $50k aggregate promo under the Partner Incentive Program with the following constraints:
1) Pilot term: 90 days from activation per account, non-extendable without explicit sign-off
2) Max per-account consumption gated at the $5k credit; any overage billed to the partner or the end customer per the SOW
3) Activation: partner must provide Marketplace account IDs and we will provision credits via the portal within 3 business days of SOW + PO (or signed acceptance)
4) Security: for pilots with >1TB of customer data ingress we require a short security attestation; Soojin can provide the template
5) Reporting: partner must accept monthly usage reports and a final reconciliation report to close out the credit pool

Ben — for deal labelling, this should be tagged CH-Partner-Promo and prevented from stacking with any other Redwood promotional discounts. Can ops flag that in the activation flow?

Soojin — I'll need the attestation template. Jordan, if you want to accelerate, I can prepare a one-page SOW and the activation checklist for Kate.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: partner-activation-checklist.txt

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lin <kate@cloudharbor.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 17:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHarbor syndicate incentive onboarding and eligibility

Kate —

Thanks for the patience. Per our internal review we can support CloudHarbor's Marketplace cohort as a partner-sourced promotional credit under the following binding conditions (short form):

1) Scope: up to 10 Marketplace accounts, $5,000 Redwood credit per account, 90-day trial period from activation (total pool not to exceed $50,000)
2) Activation: CloudHarbor must register each end-customer account in our partner portal and provide Marketplace account IDs. Redwood will issue credits within 3 business days of receiving the signed SOW + PO.
3) Security/Compliance: pilots with heavy data ingress (>1TB) must complete the Redwood Pilot Security Attestation (attached). No customer data will be retained beyond the pilot unless otherwise agreed.
4) Reporting/Reconciliation: monthly usage reports; final reconciliation within 30 days of pilot end. Any overage beyond the allocated credit is billed to the partner or end customer per SOW.
5) Accounting: this will be recorded as a partner promotion (deal label: CH-Partner-Promo); credits cannot be combined with other Redwood promotions.

Next steps:
- I attached a one-page SOW draft and an estimated-usage template for your team to complete. Please return with Marketplace account IDs and a PO or signed acceptance and we will provision the credits.
- Vanessa and Soojin are on copy for activation and security questions. Ben will confirm final deal labelling in the portal.

If you want, we can schedule a short call early next week to run through the onboarding checklist.

Best regards,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: CloudHarbor_Promo_SOW_draft.pdf; estimated-usage-by-cohort.xlsx
